description: Estimate salary distribution (median, P25/P75, min/max) for a professional role in a region by sampling posted vacancy salaries client-side. Biased sample (only vacancies that disclose salary) — not official market data.

area_id.description: Region code (1=Moscow, 2=Saint Petersburg). Use get_areas to find codes.

professional_role_id.description: Professional role ID. Use get_professional_roles or suggest_positions to find IDs.

raw.description: Return the computed stats object as JSON instead of the formatted summary.

sample_pages.description: Pages of 100 salaried vacancies to sample (1-5). More = better estimate, more API calls.

text.description: Optional keyword to narrow the role (e.g. 'senior python').

name: get_salary_statistics
